name: libxsmm-k-loop-counter-schedule
hypothesis: Moving the counter decrement before the four FMOPA instructions may reduce exposed loop-control latency. This implements only the selected scheduling change in Llibxsmm_478 and Llibxsmm_70c. Each loop retains 512 iterations, the same loads and pointer updates, unchanged FP32 accumulation order, and the branch after all four FMOPA operations. The supplied history contains no identical change. All other code, including the complete BSD notice, packing, ABI, streaming transitions and general-size fallback, remains unchanged. Assembly, correctness and performance are untested. Validation requires the fixed compiler flags, 0.002 tolerance, general-size and boundary checks, and fresh repeated paired controls on unchanged battery power and settings. No speedup is established.

edits.old:
"Llibxsmm_478:
"
    "ld1w	{ z0.s, z1.s }, pn8/z, [x0]
"
    "ld1w	{ z2.s, z3.s }, pn9/z, [x3]
"
    "add	x0, x0, x9
"
    "add	x3, x3, x10
"
    "fmopa	za0.s, p1/m, p0/m, z2.s, z0.s
"
    "fmopa	za1.s, p1/m, p2/m, z2.s, z1.s
"
    "fmopa	za2.s, p3/m, p0/m, z3.s, z0.s
"
    "fmopa	za3.s, p3/m, p2/m, z3.s, z1.s
"
    "sub	x8, x8, #0x1
"
    "cbnz	x8, Llibxsmm_478
"
